topic: Fixing unique counts in CityMedia data
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on a discrepancy where the number of unique users exceeded the number of sessions in the CityMedia data. It was determined that this was due to a bug in the aggregation process, specifically related to how multi-session days were counted.

The fix involved ensuring that for a given device, only the first session of the day is counted towards both the session count and the unique user count (for hourly breakdowns). This rule applies only to CityMedia data. The overall daily unique counts will remain unchanged, but the hourly breakdown will be corrected so that unique users do not exceed sessions in later hours.
decisions: The aggregation logic for CityMedia was fixed to correctly handle multi-session days.
action_items: A dataset with the fix needs to be added/uploaded.
